primitives.name: Resource Schema Translation Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: --name: new-resource description: Add a bindings resource schema --# Create a New Resource Creates a resource module in `packages/bindings` by investigating a source repo and translating the resource shape into Zod schemas and TypeScript types.
primitives.assumptions: The source repository contains structured data that can be mapped to Zod schemas and TypeScript interfaces.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When the source repository lacks explicit resource definition, user input is required to proceed.

layer2.mapping: Maps source data structures to Zod schemas and TypeScript types via a deterministic transformation function.
layer2.telemetry: Validation success rate of generated schemas against source data.

primitives.name: Dependency Build Sequence Validator
primitives.verbatim_quote: pes build` if `packages/types` changed - Run `pnpm --filter @polymarket/bindings build` - Run `pnpm --filter @polymarket/bindings typecheck` - If the resource is consumed by another workspace package in the same task, build `@polymarket/bindings` before validating that dependent package.
primitives.assumptions: Build artifacts must be consistent with upstream changes in related packages.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when dependent packages are not rebuilt before validation.

layer2.mapping: Ensures correct sequencing of builds and typechecks to maintain integrity of interdependent modules.
layer2.telemetry: Number of failed builds due to outdated dependencies.

primitives.name: Schema Naming Convention Enforcer
primitives.verbatim_quote: with `export * from './<module>'` ## Schema Rules - Use `PascalCaseSchema` for exported Zod schemas -
primitives.assumptions: Consistent naming improves code readability and reduces ambiguity in schema usage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Naming convention violations lead to inconsistent schema references and potential runtime errors.

layer2.mapping: Enforces uniformity between Zod schema names and their corresponding TypeScript types using PascalCase.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of schemas adhering to PascalCase naming standard.
